column1: # How lStewieAl's Tweaks 10.05 reads a key from more than one file (settings.h HandleIniFile, run for
# the main INI, then for each Tweaks\INIs\*.ini). Columns: rule, section, key. `main`: read only inside
# `if (isDefaultINI)`, so an overlay file's value is ignored (28 keys). `or`: read with GET_TWEAKH
# (SettingUtils.h: `g_Name |= ini.GetLongValue("Tweaks", Name, 0)`), so each file's value is ORed in:
# an overlay can turn the key on, never off (69 keys). Every other key: the last file that has it wins.
